She was the daughter of king Belala II and is known for her military victories, including the successful defense against the invading forces of the Western Chalukyas.

Another Sharvitha, who is also believed to be a queen, is mentioned in the ancient Indian epic Mahabharata. She is the wife of Bhishma Pitamaha and is known for her unwavering devotion to her husband, who lies on a bed of arrows for over fifty years, awaiting his time to die.
